objectives.description: Use Yoruba greetings, expressions of courtesy, and formulaic exchanges in everyday conversations
Perform oral drills to master correct Yoruba sounds, tones, and pronunciation patterns
Carry out simple dialogues and role plays on familiar topics in Yoruba
Identify and recite Yoruba proverbs, ewi, ijala, and rara, and explain their meanings
Listen to and retell Yoruba folktales, riddles, and oral narratives with comprehension
Identify letters, vowels, consonants, and tonal marks of the Yoruba orthography and write them correctly
Construct simple, compound, and complex sentences in Yoruba using correct grammar and syntax
Identify and use Yoruba parts of speech (nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives) in sentences
Express time, numbers, days of the week, and months in Yoruba correctly
Apply tonal marks and diacritical symbols specific to Yoruba writing conventions
Read simple Yoruba texts aloud with correct pronunciation, fluency, and expression
Identify main ideas and supporting details in Yoruba reading passages
Write simple compositions, descriptions, and narratives in Yoruba using appropriate vocabulary
Build Yoruba vocabulary on familiar topics including home, school, community, and the environment
Write letters, messages, and short notes in Yoruba using appropriate register and format
Identify and interpret Yoruba poems, songs, and praise poetry in Yoruba
Read and analyse Yoruba drama texts identifying plot, characters, and themes
Describe the cultural significance of Yoruba oral traditions including ewi, ijala, and rara and riddles
Appreciate the role of Yoruba language in preserving Nigerian cultural identity and heritage
